name: PROJECT MIRO: It's For Research, We Swear!
source:
Two students are assigned to work together on their thesis. When an accident ends with both of them getting splashed by a love potion and other chemicals, they decide that the topic of their thesis will be about these “new, undiscovered effects” of love potions that they’re experiencing.

But what does love mean if entangled by a potion?  What does a heart-warming compliment or a loving smile mean when laced in its toxins?

Follow their research ventures and late night studies as they find the cure, both for themselves and their grades... These effects are getting way too intense.


[From [url=https://delve-murder-nevermore.itch.io/project-miro]itch.io[/url]]
